offering_description.value: The Trade Desk provides a self-service platform that advertising agencies and brands use to buy digital ads. The platform connects buyers to ad inventory across connected TV, websites, apps, and streaming audio, and provides tools for targeting, optimizing, and measuring campaigns.

primary_products.value: programmatic ad-buying software; audience targeting and identity tools; campaign measurement software; publisher inventory integrations

primary_services.value: audience data access; campaign measurement services

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertising agencies, agency holding companies, and brands with in-house media buying teams

end_markets.value: digital advertising; connected TV and streaming media; web and mobile publishing; digital audio; digital out-of-home advertising

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: platform fees typically based on a percentage of ad spend, plus charges for audience data and other add-ons

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: connects ad inventory from publishers and exchanges and data from providers with agencies and brand advertisers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: programmatic ad buying, audience data and identity, campaign measurement, and publisher integrations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving advertising agencies, holding companies, and brand advertisers; online: self-service ad-buying platform for agency and brand teams

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: targeted advertising and handling of audience data under GDPR and state privacy laws such as California’s CCPA

notes: The current commercial scope of its newer connected TV operating system initiative is uncertain.
